title: More ways to make and work with images and audio
summary:
New image, audio, and chat options landed alongside sturdier client integrations, community-made plugins, and a Bee Census that asks what to build next.

Lightning Image Turbo adds text-to-image generation with up to two reference images. GPT Image 1.5 can try another Azure region, then OpenAI direct, when a deployment refuses a request. Audio gained Gemini 3.5 transcription with timestamps and speaker labels, ElevenLabs stem separation, and two Azure-backed speech models. Claude Sonnet 5.5 also arrived for long-context chat with images and tools.

An Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages route lets Anthropic SDKs and Claude Code use chat-capable models, while a Fireworks fix handles cache markers those models cannot accept. Floret accepts ag_, sk_, and pk_ bearer keys; API keys can have longer or no expiry; and daily usage filters work by key again. Vision requests now get a clear error when a model cannot read images, and concurrent Stripe webhooks add just one wallet pack per completed auto top-up.

polli gen now covers prompt-to-3D, image-to-3D, embeddings, voice changing, audio isolation, and speech timing. Hermes Agent gained a Pollinations harness and MCP server management; Hermes, DSH, Pi, and Prime harnesses now start with available tool-calling defaults. The generated API reference was synced with the deployed spec.

highlights.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5
highlights.text: Use `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5` for chats with images, tools, adaptive reasoning, and up to 1M tokens of context. [See available models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Claude Code, meet Pollinations
highlights.text: The new Anthropic-compatible `/v1/messages` endpoint supports streaming, tools, and thinking across chat-capable models. Point `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` at `https://gen.pollinations.ai`.

highlights.title: Lightning Image Turbo
highlights.text: Generate images from a prompt, with up to two reference images for guidance, through the image API. [Explore image models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/models).

highlights.title: Audio gets more useful
highlights.text: Transcribe with Gemini 3.5 for word timestamps and speaker labels, or split a recording into two or six stems with ElevenLabs. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: More voices for speech
highlights.text: `openai/tts-1` and `openai/tts-1-hd` are now available through the existing speech endpoints. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Polli CLI grows a third dimension
highlights.text: Generate 3D files from text or images with `polli gen 3d`; the CLI also adds voice changing, audio isolation, and speech timestamps. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Pollinations inside Figma
highlights.text: Generate and edit images on the canvas with a community-built plugin using your own Pollen. [View repo](https://github.com/xiaotian1171/pollinations-figma)
